rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something stylish, upscale, or exclusive.

example.english: This restaurant is posh, but not outrageously expensive.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳環境高級，但價錢唔算離譜。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 waan4 ging2 gou1 kap1 daan6 gaa3 cin4 m4 syun3 lei4 pou2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on conspicuous luxury or lavishness rather than general style.

example.english: They held a posh wedding banquet at the hotel.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺酒店搞咗個豪華婚宴。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zau2 dim3 gaau2 zo2 go3 hou4 waa4 fan1 jin3

rows.note: Use this for an upper-class or aristocratic style, such as a posh accent or manner.

example.english: You can tell from his posh accent that he comes from an unusual background.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢嗰種貴族式口音，一聽就知出身唔普通。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 go2 zung2 gwai3 zuk6 sik1 hau2 jam1 jat1 teng1 zau6 zi1 ceot1 san1 m4 pou2 tung1
